text: Visitor reviews over the last 30 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several comments mention salads lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and one dish was described as bland. There were also concerns about the limited menu range and the absence of cups for water. Additionally, one review noted that the food was overpriced given the portion sizes. Overall, the average rating was low, reflecting dissatisfaction primarily with dining experiences.

windows.90: Over the past 90 days, several visitors have expressed dissatisfaction with the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, noting issues with flavor, limited menu choices, and preparation quality. Some found certain dishes bland or poorly executed, and there were complaints about the lack of variety and absence of common sides like chips or fries. A few reviews also mentioned concerns about pricing and service, including the refusal to provide cups for water. While the library itself received positive remarks, the food service appears to need attention to better meet visitor expectations.
